final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) as col2, AVG(t.balance) as col3 FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.col2 as col2, s1.col3 as col3, s1.col2 - s2.overall_avg as col4 FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.col2 > s2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(col2) as result_col2, AVG(col3) as result_col3, AVG(col4) as result_col4 FROM step3
